name: Buffer
whatYouLose: Stable publishing integrations across many social networks
Vendor-managed responses to constant API policy changes
Rich approval workflows and social listening
prompt: Create a social publishing calendar for X, LinkedIn and Mastodon. Users can connect accounts with OAuth, draft posts, upload media, schedule posts in a timezone, maintain an approval queue, reuse evergreen posts, and view first-party delivery logs. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript, SQLite, a durable job runner, idempotent publishing and encrypted tokens. Include provider adapters so each social API is isolated and replaceable.
notes: The dashboard is easy. Reliable access to third-party APIs is the business. Expect ongoing maintenance whenever platforms change their rules.
